about_the_game:
What is Idle Farm Tycoon The game is based on click game, and farm game we have fed these together to a completely separate play game. Nice relaxing gaming, but also busy with farm simulation at the same time. Like inreal life you get nothing for nothing. You have to do something for it

You expand your farm by buying more and more fields, so that you get more yield. You have Wheat, for the chickens and Corn for the cows, and potatoes for the pigs. You use these yields for your animals, these animals eat the harvest yields. The animals in turn give products, which are sold so that you can buy new animals or fields. You start with 1 Wheat field and 1 chicken, you then have to expand this further, after a certain time you can expand the farm with a new product Corn and then the cows come. After some time a new product comes again and so on

By buying tractors you can speed up production and even make it completely automatic. The more tractors you buy the faster the process will run and you can earn money much faster Each type of field has its own tractor color so you know which field you are buying a tractor for. Finally, they are not cheap, The prices increase per purchase each tractor has its own properties that help you to make faster and more products.

If you have expanded your farm that much you will get the opportunity to do a Rebith, Then you start over completely but with more advantage than when you first played. These rebirths are kept in a score list try to get to the top with your farm
